intro: Hands-on security operations, audit and infrastructure labs, each documented with step-by-step evidence.

items.title: IT audit: OpenMRS EMR on AWS
items.summary: Internal audit of a hospital's EMR on AWS EC2 and RDS: access control, encryption, monitoring and recovery tested against ISO/IEC 27001, NIST SP 800-53 and the HIPAA Security Rule, with risk-rated findings and a corrective action plan.

items.title: Hashing, data integrity and encryption
items.summary: Verifying data integrity with cryptographic hashes and applying encryption and website security controls.

items.title: Microsoft Sentinel SIEM: setup and log ingestion
items.summary: Deployed Sentinel on a Log Analytics workspace, onboarded an on-premises machine through Azure Arc, built data collection rules for Windows security events and analysed the logs with KQL.

items.title: Threat intelligence and threat hunting in Microsoft Sentinel
items.summary: Gathering threat intelligence and hunting for malicious activity across ingested security logs.

items.title: Wazuh SIEM: configuring and monitoring security events
items.summary: Configuring the open-source Wazuh SIEM and monitoring the security events it collects.

items.title: Honeypot and canary token monitoring
items.summary: Deploying deception controls and monitoring the alerts they raise to detect intruders early.

items.title: Phishing email analysis
items.summary: Triage of suspicious emails to identify phishing indicators and decide on a response.

items.title: Vulnerability scanning with Nessus
items.summary: Running authenticated vulnerability scans and reviewing the findings by severity.

items.title: Network scanning with Nmap on Kali Linux
items.summary: Building a Kali virtual machine and mapping hosts, open ports and services with Nmap.

items.title: Network traffic capture and analysis
items.summary: Capturing traffic with Wireshark and tcpdump, then detecting and analysing suspicious network activity.

items.title: Cisco network security labs: VLANs, ACLs and port security
items.summary: Network simulation in Cisco Packet Tracer: VLAN segmentation, access control lists and switch port security.

items.title: Active Directory and Group Policy security
items.summary: Implementing Active Directory and enforcing security baselines through Group Policy.

items.title: Linux administration and security labs
items.summary: File, user, permission, process and network management on Linux, plus a multi-OS virtual lab.
